name: klay60
caption:
60 IN 29 MINUTES? 🎮🏀 Klay Thompson scored 60 points and only played three quarters.

• Dec 5, 2016 vs Indiana: 40 points by halftime
• 21 of 33 from the field, 8 of 14 from three
• First player in NBA history to score 60 in under 30 minutes
• Our first 60-point game since Rick Barry's 64 in 1974
• We won 142-106

60 in 29 minutes or 37 in one quarter: which Klay game was better? 👇
